checks.description: GCP Compute instances must explicitly configure a dedicated service account rather than relying on the default Compute Engine service account
checks.impact: The default Compute Engine service account has broad Editor-level permissions on the project. Instances using it inherit those permissions, violating least-privilege and enabling privilege escalation if the instance is compromised
checks.resolution: Add a service_account block to google_compute_instance with a custom, minimally-scoped service account email. Do not omit the block or use the default -compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com account
checks.errorMessage: GCP Compute instance does not have an explicit service_account block (default service account may be used — violates least-privilege)
